Container.Name: Posteryard
Container.Overview: Clean, consistent posters for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby, picked, rendered and kept current automatically.[br][br]Posteryard gives every movie, show, season and episode the same calm look: clean art without printed text, the title logo in one fixed spot, a soft fade, and small badges for 4K, Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos and the streaming service. It finds the art on TMDB, checks it, renders it, uploads it and keeps it up to date. With Live TV on, it does the same for the shows and movies in the Plex or Jellyfin guide.[br][br]It starts with Dry Run on: images go to the previews folder in Data and the server is not touched. Set Dry Run to false when you like them.[br][br]For new titles right away, add the webhook http://UNRAID-IP:8098/webhook/YOUR-WEBHOOK-SECRET in Plex under Settings, Webhooks. For Jellyfin and Emby, see the README. Without it, new titles get posters within 15 minutes.
Container.Requires: A free TMDB API key and a Plex, Jellyfin or Emby server.
Container.Changes:
### 0.10.3 - 2026-11-08
#### Changed
- Use less memory on large libraries and Live TV guides, and save the guide much faster on spinning disks. - Check large libraries faster: a show's items are processed together, a show is read once for its seasons and episodes, and memory cleanup no longer runs after every unchanged title. On Jellyfin and Emby this removes most TMDB requests of the daily check. - Download less art on repeat checks: comparisons between pictures and the shape of Live TV art are saved instead of worked out again. - Check a title again every 3 days, not on every pass, when one of its art candidates cannot be read and a good one was found.
#### Fixed
- Print a message when `art set` gets a malformed address. It ended with a traceback. - Stop skipping good art because a short title is part of another printed word, such as UNITED for Ted, or because one word from the middle of a title is printed on it. Titles already checked keep their art until their art candidates change. - Show art in Adobe RGB, Display P3 or CMYK in the right colours. It came out dull or with wrong colours. - Render 16-bit greyscale art with its real brightness. It came out pure white. - Keep large palette images smooth, and stop colour stored under transparent pixels from showing on a poster. - The colour, brightness and transparency fixes reach a poster when it is next uploaded. Posters already uploaded stay as they are. - Keep a title's records, custom art and restore data when a proxy answers 404 or Jellyfin sends an empty answer while the server is down. Posteryard now confirms with the server that a title is gone. - Find titles again when the Jellyfin administrator Posteryard picked is deleted while it runs. Every title looked deleted. - Stop saving a temporary block, such as HTTP 403 or a filter's HTML page, as "this title has no art", no logo or no service mark. The art is tried again. - Keep the Apple TV art already found when Apple's page cannot be read. The title lost it for 30 days. - Keep a Live TV poster during a short outage of a channel logo or guide picture host. It was uploaded without the image, then uploaded again. - Keep an uploaded poster during an Apple TV outage. It was replaced by other art, then replaced again. - Keep watching for new titles and retries when one page of the daily full listing keeps failing. - Stop looking up every show or airing after repeated network failures, so an outage no longer blocks the schedule for hours or restarts the service. - Wait as long as `Retry-After` asks, across titles. Posteryard asked again after 60 seconds. - Keep updating a Jellyfin or Emby image after its tag changes without a person, such as after restoring a backup. It counted as a change by hand. This covers images uploaded by this release or later. - Add no second Jellyfin or Emby background when a background upload is retried. - Let `restore --all` go on after a malformed answer. It stopped at that title and skipped the rest. - Limit the time spent reading XMLTV guides for Jellyfin pictures, so unreachable guide hosts no longer trip the health check. - Match a Live TV movie to the TMDB film of the year the guide gives, so an older film no longer gets a remake's poster. - Recognise a title printed on art without its accents, such as AMELIE for Amélie, and skip that art. - Recognise a printed two-letter title, such as IT for It, and skip that art. - Leave service collections unchanged while `ONLY_RATING_KEYS` is set. A first test changed them for the whole library. - Keep a service collection you renamed. Posteryard deleted it and made it again under the service name. - Find new and changed titles at the next sweep when the media server's clock is behind Posteryard's. They waited for the daily pass. - Find titles in a folder added to a Jellyfin or Emby library while Posteryard runs. They were skipped until a restart. - Find an episode's still by its TVDB or IMDb id when the server numbers episodes in another order than TMDB, such as DVD or absolute order. These episodes showed another episode's still. - Keep the art taken with `posteryard-custom` after `forget` or after removing `posteryard-ignore`. Posteryard took its own poster as the art, drew the title twice and deleted the original. - Go back to automatic art at the next sweep after `posteryard-custom` is removed, not at the daily pass. - Let a paused Live TV run go on from where it stopped. A title with `posteryard-custom` restarted it at every sweep, so a long guide was never finished. - Turn custom art and other images upright when their EXIF data says they are rotated. - Skip a TMDB logo that is gone or cannot be read and use the next one, so the title still gets a poster. - Skip an Apple TV page that is nested too deeply to read, so the title gets other art. - Close idle connections to the media server and other services within 30 seconds, so a firewall no longer logs blocked packets when Posteryard closes them late. - Give back with `restore --all` the Plex image shown before Posteryard's first upload, such as a poster you uploaded yourself. It selected the server's first own image. This covers images uploaded by this release or later. - Find every upload with `restore --all`, also after `forget`, after removing `posteryard-ignore`, or after a dry run that followed an interrupted upload. Those images stayed on the server, locked. - Keep posters and thumbnails you changed by hand after `restore --all` and after `EPISODE_THUMBNAILS=off`. Starting again or turning thumbnails on again replaced them. - Retry an upload whose Plex lock failed. The image counted as done, and a Plex refresh then replaced it for good. - Keep an image you choose on the server while a failed upload waits for its retry. On Plex this covers the server's own images, not a file you upload yourself. - Find new titles at the next sweep when an item is dated in the future. They waited until that date passed. - Draw at most 40 words and 300 characters of a very long guide title, so it cannot fill the memory. - Try Live TV shows again within an hour after a network failure. They waited for the next guide refresh or a day. - Quote values in the landing page's `docker run` and Docker Compose lines, so the pasted command works and no library is lost. - Make the landing page's install picker, menus, feature row and copy buttons move without jumps and stay on screen, and fix their keyboard and screen reader behaviour.
#### Security
- Update oauthlib to 4.0.1 for CVE-2026-49272. Posteryard does not use the affected OAuth server flow. - Read only JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF images. Other formats could fill the memory before the size check, or stop the Live TV run at the same channel on every sweep. - Check redirects from TMDB, Wikidata and Apple TV like guide pictures, so they cannot reach Posteryard's own machine or a cloud metadata service. - Ignore TMDB image paths that are not TMDB file names, so a changed TMDB answer cannot point at a file inside the container. - Resize only the part of an image that ends up in the poster, so a very thin image cannot fill the memory.

Config.Name: Webhook Port
Config.Description: Port for the Plex, Jellyfin or Emby webhook and the /healthz check.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, previews and custom art. Keep this, or every image is rendered and uploaded again.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: A free key from TMDB, under Settings, API. The API Read Access Token works too.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Your Plex server's address on the network, such as http://192.168.1.10:32400. Not localhost. Leave it empty for Jellyfin or Emby.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Your Plex token. Leave it empty for Jellyfin or Emby.

Config.Name: Webhook Secret
Config.Description: Any long random text, such as the output of openssl rand -hex 16. It is part of the webhook address.

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: true saves previews and changes nothing on your server. false uploads the images and locks them.

Config.Name: Libraries
Config.Description: Libraries to manage, separated by commas, named as your server shows them. Movie and TV libraries only. PLEX_LIBRARIES works too.

Config.Name: Streaming Regions
Config.Description: Countries to look up a show's streaming service in, in order. Outside the US, put yours first, such as GB,US.

Config.Name: Notify URLs
Config.Description: Where alerts go: Apprise addresses separated by spaces or commas, for Discord, Telegram, ntfy, email and about 100 more.

Config.Name: Notify Events
Config.Description: Which alerts are sent: problems, new and summary.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Your Jellyfin server's address. Use it instead of PLEX_URL and PLEX_TOKEN.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Key
Config.Description: A Jellyfin API key, from API Keys in the Jellyfin dashboard.

Config.Name: Emby URL
Config.Description: Your Emby server's address. Use it instead of PLEX_URL and PLEX_TOKEN.

Config.Name: Emby API Key
Config.Description: An Emby API key, from API Keys in the Emby dashboard.

Config.Name: Maintainerr URL
Config.Description: Your Maintainerr address, for the LEAVING IN 5 DAYS countdown.

Config.Name: fanart.tv API Key
Config.Description: Your fanart.tv API key. A second art source when TMDB has nothing clean.

Config.Name: Apple TV Art
Config.Description: Use Apple TV's key art when TMDB has no textless poster.

Config.Name: Text Check
Config.Description: Check art for printed titles and skip it. false saves about 350 MB of memory on small machines, but a few posters may show the title twice.

Config.Name: Only Rating Keys
Config.Description: Limit Posteryard to a few titles, for a first test. Rating keys separated by commas. A show includes its seasons and episodes. Service collections are left alone.

Config.Name: Minimum Video Badge
Config.Description: Lowest resolution that gets a badge: off, 720, 1080 or 2160.

Config.Name: Minimum HDR Badge
Config.Description: Lowest HDR format that gets a badge: off, hdr10, hdr10plus or dolbyvision.

Config.Name: Minimum Audio Badge
Config.Description: Lowest audio that gets a badge: off, 5.1, 7.1 or atmos. DTS:X counts as atmos.

Config.Name: Accessibility Badges
Config.Description: Subtitle and audio description badges on movies: any of sdh, cc and ad, separated by commas. Read from the track flags, or from track names such as "English (SDH)".

Config.Name: Status Labels
Config.Description: JUST ADDED, NEW EPISODE and NEW SEASON labels. false turns them off.

Config.Name: Episode Thumbnails
Config.Description: plain adds a light shade, titled adds the episode number and title, off gives episodes back their server thumbnails.

Config.Name: Logo Languages
Config.Description: Title logo languages in order, such as fr,en.

Config.Name: Prefer Wordmark
Config.Description: Prefer a wide logo with the name written out. false allows tall or square logos.

Config.Name: Collection Posters
Config.Description: Give every collection a poster.

Config.Name: Live TV
Config.Description: Posters for the shows and movies in the Live TV guide, on Plex and Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Service Collections
Config.Description: Keep one collection per streaming service with at least 3 shows.

Config.Name: Sweep Minutes
Config.Description: Minutes between checks for new and changed titles.

Config.Name: Daily Pass At
Config.Description: Time of the daily full pass, as HH:MM in your TZ.

Config.Name: Heartbeat URL
Config.Description: An address Posteryard calls every minute while healthy, such as an Uptime Kuma push URL.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: debug, info, warning or error.
